titleHi: सकाल रिपोर्ट: मनपा आयुक्त द्वारा उत्साहपूर्वक निःशुल्क पाठ्यपुस्तक वितरण एवं शालेय प्रवेशोत्सव
excerpt: Daily Sakal reports Chandrapur Municipal Commissioner and education officers personally welcoming students on the first day of school with flowers and free textbooks.
excerptMr: Daily Sakal reports Chandrapur Municipal Commissioner and education officers personally welcoming students on the first day of school with flowers and free textbooks.
excerptHi: Daily Sakal reports Chandrapur Municipal Commissioner and education officers personally welcoming students on the first day of school with flowers and free textbooks.
content: Chandrapur Municipal Corporation School Praveshotsav was celebrated with great pomp. The Municipal Commissioner, accompanied by senior administrative officers and education inspectors, visited P.M. Shri Savitribai Phule School Babupeth. Students were garlanded and presented with sets of new textbooks and notebooks. The Commissioner lauded the modern digital classroom infrastructure and green campus initiatives, encouraging parents to take full advantage of state-of-the-art municipal education.

title: Municipal School Pioneers Bagless Day ('दप्तरविना शाळा') Initiative
titleEn: Municipal School Pioneers Bagless Day ('दप्तरविना शाळा') Initiative
titleMr: नवराष्ट्र वृत्त: मनपाचा स्तुत्य उपक्रम — दप्तरविना शाळा! शनिवार ठरला आनंददायी शिक्षणाचा दिवस
titleHi: नवराष्ट्र रिपोर्ट: मनपा की सराहनीय पहल — बस्ता-मुक्त शनिवार बना आनंददायी शिक्षा का दिन
excerpt: Daily Navarashtra highlights our school's innovative 'Bagless Saturday' where children engage in hands-on science, arts, sports, and life skills without textbook burdens.
excerptMr: Daily Navarashtra highlights our school's innovative 'Bagless Saturday' where children engage in hands-on science, arts, sports, and life skills without textbook burdens.
excerptHi: Daily Navarashtra highlights our school's innovative 'Bagless Saturday' where children engage in hands-on science, arts, sports, and life skills without textbook burdens.
content: Under the visionary guidance of the Chandrapur Municipal Corporation Education Department, P.M. Shri Savitribai Phule High School introduced Bagless Saturdays. The initiative aims to relieve students of heavy school bags while igniting creative inquiry through hands-on activities, yoga, clay modelling, theatre, gardening, and spoken English workshops. Parents and community members have widely appreciated this joyful pedagogical transformation.

title: Dignity of Labor: 200 Students Learn Traditional Cooking and Values
titleEn: Dignity of Labor: 200 Students Learn Traditional Cooking and Values
titleMr: लोकमत वृत्त: भाकरी बनवण्याचा अनुभव आणि कष्टाचा गोडवा — २०० विद्यार्थ्यांनी अनुभवली श्रमप्रतिष्ठा
titleHi: लोकमत रिपोर्ट: पारंपरिक रोटी निर्माण का अनुभव और श्रम प्रतिष्ठा — 200 छात्रों ने सीखा स्वावलंबन
excerpt: Daily Lokmat features our unique life-skills workshop where 200 students learned to make traditional jowar bhakri, appreciating manual labor and household sustainability.
excerptMr: Daily Lokmat features our unique life-skills workshop where 200 students learned to make traditional jowar bhakri, appreciating manual labor and household sustainability.
excerptHi: Daily Lokmat features our unique life-skills workshop where 200 students learned to make traditional jowar bhakri, appreciating manual labor and household sustainability.
content: In an experiential learning session fostering self-reliance and empathy for daily household labor, over 200 boys and girls learned the technique of kneading dough and baking traditional jowar/bajra bhakri over earthen chulhas under teacher supervision. The story captured regional attention as an exemplary model of connecting classroom learning with living cultural traditions and mutual respect.

title: Deshonnati: School Spearheads Community Tobacco-Free Awareness Drive
titleEn: Deshonnati: School Spearheads Community Tobacco-Free Awareness Drive
titleMr: देशोन्नती वृत्त: मनपा सावित्रीबाई फुले शाळेत तंबाखू व्यसनमुक्ती जनजागृती अभियान
titleHi: देशोन्नती रिपोर्ट: विद्यालय में तंबाखू व्यसनमुक्ति जागरूकता अभियान
excerpt: Daily Deshonnati covers student-led rally and oath ceremony promoting 100% tobacco-free school zones and healthy youth lifestyles in Babupeth.
excerptMr: Daily Deshonnati covers student-led rally and oath ceremony promoting 100% tobacco-free school zones and healthy youth lifestyles in Babupeth.
excerptHi: Daily Deshonnati covers student-led rally and oath ceremony promoting 100% tobacco-free school zones and healthy youth lifestyles in Babupeth.
content: Students and faculty organized a high-impact anti-tobacco awareness campaign across Babupeth. Carrying handmade posters, slogans, and banners, students informed neighborhood shopkeepers of COTPA regulations prohibiting tobacco sales within 100 yards of school premises. The initiative was praised by civic and health authorities.

titleEn: Annual Mathematics Model Exhibition & Hands-on Lab Day

content: Students from classes 5 through 10 held their flagship Mathematics Exhibition in the school auditorium. With interactive balances, fraction wheels, 3D polyhedral nets, and algebraic tiles, students explained mathematical theorems directly to visiting teachers, parents, and education officers. Prizes were awarded for originality and conceptual clarity.

titleEn: Eco Club 'Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam' Mega Plantation & Kitchen Garden Drive
titleMr: पर्यावरण मंडळ: 'एक पेड माँ के नाम' भव्य वृक्षारोपण व परसबाग संवर्धन मोहीम
titleHi: पर्यावरण क्लब: 'एक पेड़ माँ के नाम' सघन पौधरोपण एवं पोषण वाटिका संवर्धन

excerptMr: Students planted over 100 fruit and shade saplings across campus and expanded the organic kitchen garden with seasonal vegetables.
excerptHi: Students planted over 100 fruit and shade saplings across campus and expanded the organic kitchen garden with seasonal vegetables.
content: Under the national 'Ek Ped Maa Ke Naam' program, the school Eco Club planted native shade and medicinal saplings (Neem, Peepal, Karanj, Guava, and Amla). Students dedicated plants to their mothers and committed to regular irrigation and weeding. The kitchen garden section was also enriched with organic compost prepared in the school composting pit.

titleEn: Educational Excursion to Hyderabad Historic & Scientific Landmarks

excerptHi: Students explored Charminar, Golconda Fort, Salar Jung Museum, Hussain Sagar, and Birla Science Planetarium.
content: A 4-day educational study tour took 60 upper primary and high school students to historic Hyderabad. Students gained firsthand insights into medieval architecture, heritage conservation at Salar Jung, and astronomical science at the Birla Science Planetarium. The trip was fully supervised and safe.
